leans_note: Expected lean of the UNCOUNTED vote, in points of the two-way share, positive toward Yes or the named candidate, times lean_scale. Late SF ballots skew younger and more progressive, so these follow the progressive side of each contest: the opposite of the GrowSF slate where the slates split, and the shared position where they agree. Calibrated on history/shifts_2022_2024.csv (calibrate.py): implied leans ran 2-5 points on contested local measures and candidate races, up to 8-10 in a few, with a spread of 3-4. The Great Highway lean (G) matches 2024 Prop K (+2.4 toward closing) and 2022 Prop I (-7.7 for reopening).
